column1: rr.p0011.b012;front_matter;11;9;paragraph;One very common type of die roll is called a **throw.** A throw occurs whenever a character or monster is taking an action that will **succeed or fail.** For instance

column3: his player makes an **attack throw.** When a character tries to avoid a catastrophic event
column4: his player makes a **saving throw.** When a character attempts to open a lock or bash down a door
column5: his player makes a **proficiency throw.** Most throws are resolved with 1d20.;"Один из распространённых видов броска называется **проверкой**. Проверку выполняют
